about: Deferred asks (governance/backlog.py, doc 103): anything the owner asked for that was not finished in the session that heard it, in our own words, with a due date and the next step. A session can end at any time; this file is in git, so the next session, the weekly backlog issue and ./securax backlog all see it. Close an item by setting state to done and naming where it was finished. Never put personal data, employer or bank names, or pasted document text here: the repository is public.

items.ask: Make every experience-layer feature usable by the laziest procrastinator: a one-tap, zero-input default path on every capture and decision surface, and nothing that nags or guilts. Reverse-engineered friction fixes, newest first: (1) DONE in the Inbox — one-tap lens Accept + guilt-free Later (test35). Still to do: (2) never a blank screen — seed the wheel/goals/areas with editable sample defaults on first open so a new user sees a working app, not setup; (3) a single 'Today' lazy view that answers 'the one thing' with a one-tap Done, so the 11 tabs are optional; (4) forgiving streaks — a missed day does not reset to zero (streak freeze), and overdue reads as 'waiting when you are ready', not red failure; (5) on-device voice capture as a registered lens (NOT browser SpeechRecognition — it is cloud; wait for on-device) so capture needs no typing at all; (6) smart defaults everywhere, progressive disclosure, instant visible reward on the first tap.
items.next: the principle: a feature that needs typing, a decision or config to give value excludes the people who most need it. Build each remaining item as a default path, keeping the manual controls folded away. (2) and (3) are the highest leverage next; (4) is copy + streak logic; (5) waits on on-device speech behind gmLensRegister
